title: Delegation
learning_outcomes: Explain outcomes and decision rights in the context of delegation.
Compare and distinguish capacity in the context of delegation.
Apply checkpoints in the context of delegation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about escalation in the context of delegation.

lessons.title: Outcomes and decision rights
lessons.outcome: Explain outcomes and decision rights in the context of delegation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving outcomes and decision rights; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to delegation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain outcomes and decision rights from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of outcomes and decision rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Capacity
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish capacity in the context of delegation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving capacity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to delegation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain capacity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of capacity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Checkpoints
lessons.outcome: Apply checkpoints in the context of delegation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving checkpoints; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to delegation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain checkpoints from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of checkpoints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Escalation
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about escalation in the context of delegation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving escalation; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to delegation brief.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain escalation from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of outcomes and decision rights; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of capacity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of checkpoints; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of escalation; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Experienced leader, governance or organisational psychology reviewer.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
